prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A wide-angle shot of a high school basketball team huddling on an outdoor court, captured from behind at ground level. The players, all wearing matching red shorts and white sleeveless jerseys with red trim, are bent forward in a tight circle, their heads close together in a moment of unity and focus before a game or practice. Their body language conveys determination and camaraderie. To the right, a coach or team leader in a white shirt and dark shorts stands slightly apart, observing the team with a calm, attentive posture. The court is weathered green with faded lines, and a basketball rests on the ground near the huddle. In the background, two basketball hoops stand at either end of the court, and a dense line of green trees creates a natural backdrop, with hints of a school building partially visible through the foliage. The lighting is soft and diffuse, suggesting an overcast day, lending the scene a cool, subdued color palette dominated by greens, reds, and whites. The composition emphasizes the unity of the team, with a cinematic, documentary-style realism and a sense of anticipation in the air.
